text: A21, second batch, read whole (d3b2_pq_A21_inst_1000a/b, d3b2_pq_A21_restrict_1000, d3b2_pq_A21_addcond_1000, d3b2_pk_A21_abs_1000), beside the first return's A21 lines of the same 33 rooms (d3b2_fr_A21_1000.txt). The rulings follow G32, its readings and move 176's bound, as the first batch applied them. Restrict, 2: canucks and stlouis specifications (the order, refusal being a P21 form under move 176). Add-condition, 3: stevenuniverse and yugioh specifications; crusaderkings a limit (the visitor's limit, not the room's). Absent, 5: europe-063 and sweden-069 rejected (the room carries A21, and the concepts show the order as europe-061 and sweden-058 read them); quebec-043 (not-needed) a specification (a personal limit inside a restitution offer, no agreement in force); darksouls-043 and ireland-067 limits (no agreement among the concepts; c0274's limit cannot be placed against the good terms). The 2 corrections were ruled in the first batch by G61 (1): R-adventuretime-4c65638d5e28-066 and R-weezer-c0a8b93430f3-074 repeat adventuretime-051 and weezer-063 word for word, whose corrections (paired with denmark-067 and ScottPilgrim-031) caused move 176's bound, so the repeat took their ruling. Asked of the revised model, their condition (a limit at the making of terms) is the bound's own case. This is a fact for notes-D3.md's before-and-after (the rewrite absorbed these corrections; the re-check returned them unchanged in words), and it is not a new correction met twice: both lines name a target the bound already holds. I change no ruling: G61 (1) applies as written. adjudications.jsonl 96,237 lines (wc -l). Next: the dimension lines (D01 to D07) by G58, then the 323 propose lines by G61 (2), G59 and G59a.
